REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

TARGETED T05: Preserve exact accepted T04 image 5 including its low front shop, veranda, two service windows, door, single leaf fascia and long rear sales wing. Add ONE new HIGH ROUND CORNER CUSTOMER HALL behind the unchanged servicefront at the rear-right portion of the building. The new hall is a substantial rounded drum-shaped cream-plaster volume about one-and-a-half times the original shop-wall height, with broad tall dark windows in its curved wall and a soft rounded sage roof rim. Its cream plaster is smooth broad masonry, NOT timber plank cladding. This round hall must create a large new high curved silhouette, not merely recolor or round an existing small corner. It joins solidly to the rear wing with continuous walls to ground; no floating upper room. Keep the original front ONE storey, all earlier entry/service structures and roof utility tank recognizable. No extra symbols, lamps, outdoor furniture or props. Complete single building with clear margin.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: botanical retail coffee shop, T05_L050. Exact visible state: add a tall rounded rear corner customer hall with a distinct curved roof above the original service front.
Family DNA: rounded corner facade, recessed service window, thick sage canopy. Function: botanical retail coffee shop.
Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: repaired shop with recessed service window; broad second service opening; roofed attached customer veranda; rear retail wing; add a tall rounded rear corner customer hall with a distinct curved roof above the original service front. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 14m local X by 14m local Z, maximum family height 24m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: warm plaster, reclaimed wood, sage enamel, muted turquoise; epoch treatment: warm plaster, reclaimed wood, sage enamel, first permanent service modules. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
review_notes: Visually accepted T05: substantial high rounded cream-plaster corner customer hall rises behind original low servicefront with broad curved dark windows and sage rounded roof, continuous wall support to ground. Earlier rear wing, two service openings, veranda, door and rooftop utility unit retained. Strong new community hall silhouette; single complete neutral-studio building with no persons text exterior loose props or lighting effects.
